exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 238 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag simultaneously, so tag counts can sum to slightly more than 238 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the ~101-contact bulk-import batch frozen since pipeline launch (2025-10-29/2025-10-11) and long-running Postponed records — see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric).
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 48 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (63 total). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (it runs its own +3d/+8d automated cadence) so no staleness prediction is made here.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's 24 active conversations rather than a full-account scan of every mobile-quote-tagged contact. No violations found: all mobile-quote leads with a quote >=5 days old (e.g. Noel Brillantes, Bryan Delamasa) have had at least automated outbound activity since, even where a substantive human reply is still missing (flagged separately in conversations/needs_followup). A full sweep of Warm/Cold for overdue quote follow-ups was not performed this run given volume.
